text.tspan: SATURDAY SURGE
@unhappychoice drops 525 commits on a Saturday. Authorities investigating.
FEATURE AVALANCHE
@unhappychoice stacks 6 trading features in cycle-flyer without breaking a sweat
SOUND THE ALARM
@unhappychoice adds literal notification sounds to trading app. Markets react.
REVIEW MACHINE
@unhappychoice approves 58 PRs this week. Dependabot reportedly weeping with joy.
GLOBE TROTTING
@unhappychoice relocates monoid-studio HQ to Ginza, Tokyo via git push
ANSI TRUTHER
@unhappychoice makes terminal_image render ANY image format. ImageMagick conscripted.
TWAP ATTACK
@unhappychoice ships client-side TWAP ordering to prod. Quants reportedly nervous.
NO SURVIVORS
@unhappychoice touches 13+ repos in 7 days. Dependency bots cannot keep up.
